name: Yuki no Oshikko Omorashi Jijou -Yuuenchi Date to Rinyouzai to...-
original_name: ユキのおしっこおもらし事情 -遊園地デートと利尿剤と…-
source:
After hearing Yuki tell a story of how she once wet herself on a bus,
the protagonist longs to see her like that.
During a dark at an amusement park, Yuki is given a diuretic,
and wets herself on all sorts of attractions.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE262461.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
听Yuki讲起自己曾在公交车上尿湿裤子的经历后，主角便渴望亲眼见到她那副模样。
在游乐园约会时，Yuki被喂下利尿剂，
在各种游乐设施上接连失禁。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE262461.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]]
